description: Source code implementing an audio sink using XAudio2 API for Windows, including classes for managing audio playback, callbacks, and device restart logic.

classes.name: XAudioAudioSink
classes.description: Represents an individual audio sink using XAudio2 source voice, managing playback, volume, rate, and buffer submission.

classes.name: XAudioAudioSinkType
classes.description: Manages creation, destruction, and restart of XAudio2 engine and device, and maintains list of active sinks.

methods.name: CHECK_HRESULT_OK
methods.description: Checks HRESULT for success, logs error if failed.

methods.name: SampleTypeToFormatTag
methods.description: Converts media sample type to WAVE format tag.

methods.name: SampleTypeToBitsPerSample
methods.description: Converts media sample type to bits per sample.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSink::SetSourceVoice
methods.description: Sets the source voice for playback and starts it.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSink::IsType
methods.description: Checks if the sink is of a specific type.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSink::Process
methods.description: Handles buffer submission, playback control, and callback invocation.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSink::SubmitSourceBuffer
methods.description: Submits a buffer of audio data to the source voice.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSinkType::XAudioCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes an XAudio2 engine instance.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSinkType::Create
methods.description: Creates a new audio sink with specified parameters.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSinkType::RestartAudioDevice
methods.description: Restarts the XAudio2 device and reinitializes sinks.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSinkType::TryAcquireSinkVoices
methods.description: Attempts to create source voices for sinks.

methods.name: XAudioAudioSinkType::OnProcessingPassStart
methods.description: Callback invoked periodically to process sinks during audio processing.
